This seminar hosts talks, workshops, panels, and other sessions related to the teaching and learning of mathematics.

## Fall 2026

This semester, Dr. Stepan Paul will be organizing the seminar. Se will meet Thursdays at 3pm in SAS 4201 unless otherwise noted.

If you would like to propose a session, suggest an invited speaker, or volunteer to give a talk, please reach out to Dr. Paul [sspaul2@ncsu.edu](mailto:sspaul2@ncsu.edu).
